titre: CASE OF BĂRBULESCU v. ROMANIA - [Slovenian Translation] summary by the Supreme Court of the Republic of Slovenia
conclusion: Remainder inadmissible (Art. 35) Admissibility criteria;No violation of Article 8 - Right to respect for private and family life (Article 8 - Positive obligations;Article 8-1 - Respect for correspondence;Respect for private life)
